name: Vox Obscura
about: An exotic mission for one to three players from Season of the Risen (2022) against the Cabal on Mars, ending with the Dead Messenger grenade launcher. The airfield and the control room each run on a timer, and running out fails the run. Since Monument of Triumph (June 2026) exotic missions launch from Pinnacle Ops.
sources: TheGamer: Vox Obscura exotic mission guide
Pro Game Guides: How to complete Vox Obscura
Bungie Help: Monument of Triumph and Update 9.7.0 support guide

encounters.name: Airfield
encounters.title: Clear the Airfield
encounters.before: The mission opens untimed outside a Cabal hangar. Pick off the guards from range, fight through the Psions and turrets inside, and take the Interceptors. Ram or shoot open the blast door to leave.
encounters.what: A timed vehicle fight. An orbital bombardment countdown starts, and the team has to destroy three Goliath tanks and three signal towers before it ends.
steps: Destroy the Goliath outside the hangar with Interceptor fire, or by ramming its side.
Amanda Holliday drops a Drake tank. Use it to push into the airfield and destroy the two Goliaths there.
Kill the Psion Spotters to stop the artillery strikes they call in.
The signal towers start out shielded. Break the glowing generators on each tower, then finish it with tank shells.
Destroying the third tower stops the timer. Clear the remaining enemies and blast open the bunker door with a tank.
roles: Takes out the Goliaths, the tower generators and the towers.
Kill the Spotters and adds, and help on the Goliaths with Interceptors or the second Drake.
wipes: The bombardment timer runs out (two guides give eight minutes) and the mission restarts.
Psion Spotters left alive keep calling artillery onto the team.

encounters.name: Control Room
encounters.title: Race to the Control Room
encounters.what: A second, longer timer starts inside the bunker and keeps running through the boss fight. Three terminals on the lower level have to be hacked to open the way to Qabix.
steps: Plant a Rally Banner at the bunker entrance.
Fight through the Psions, War Beasts and the Unstoppable Champion. All three objective markers lead to the same lower level.
Each terminal is guarded by a Psion Codewarden inside a Psion Commander's protective field. Get inside the field and kill the Commander up close; the Codewarden is then vulnerable.
Kill the Codewarden and use its terminal to enter one override code. Repeat at the other two terminals, then head for the boss room.
roles: Stay together, clear one terminal room at a time, and keep moving: whatever time is left carries into the boss.
wipes: Spending too long here, so the timer runs out during the boss.
Shooting a Codewarden from outside the Commander's field, which does no damage.

encounters.name: Qabix
encounters.title: Qabix, Insurgent
encounters.what: The rogue Psion leader behind the broadcast. He moves fast, is hard to hit, and turns immune at each third of his health.
steps: Damage Qabix until he turns immune and calls in support.
Kill the three Psion Commanders around the room (left, right and back). Their fields block damage from outside, so go in close.
With all three dead, Qabix can be damaged again. The fight has three damage phases.
If Qabix's purple dome traps you, destroy the bright orbs on its surface and it lets you go.
When he dies the timer stops. Follow the marker to the console to shut off the broadcast.
roles: Burst Qabix in each damage phase, then split up to kill the three Commanders quickly.
wipes: The timer carried over from the control room runs out.
Standing in the open in front of the Scorpius turrets on the central pillar.
A full team wipe sends you back to the start of the control room section.
